changes.comment: The vault's sync state moved out of the header and down beside the vault's own name, where it says a word — Synced, Syncing, Diverged, Offline — instead of printing the status key.

The file navigator's toolbar stays put while the tree scrolls under it, the note you are looking at is revealed in the tree wherever it was opened from, a new folder is revealed and becomes the place the next new note lands, and dragging the navigator's edge far enough to the left closes it — reopening restores the width you had.
